weakness: Shared HMI and remote sign-ins; no account types, approvals, reviews, or termination link; former operator-mechanic's portal account active until 2026-07-21
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-002; P03 G-041
remediation_plan: Termination checklist (POL-02 B.6); named accounts on the new remote access path (with POAM-002); quarterly reconciliation of every account list (POL-02 B.7); named HMI accounts with the replacement HMI
milestones: 2026-07-21 portal account removed (done); 2026-09-30 termination checklist in use; 2026-11-30 named remote accounts; 2026-12-31 first quarterly reconciliation; 2027-03-31 named HMI accounts

weakness: Remote desktop tool gives unattended full control of gates and units with one shared password and no MFA; no written authorization or usage rules for any remote path
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives; log reconciliation); P01 R-001; P03 G-041, G-013
remediation_plan: One remote access path: business plan of the remote access tool with named accounts, MFA, view-only by default, remote commands only for alarm response or with approval, and a phone alert at every session start; written remote access rules (POL-02 B.2, B.4)
milestones: 2026-08-12 shared password changed and limited to 5 staff (done); 2026-10-15 tool plan purchased; 2026-11-30 named accounts, MFA, view-only default, and alerts live; old unattended access removed
resources_required: About $1,400 a year (tool plan) and about $2,000 integrator setup

weakness: Remote desktop tool, industrial firewall administrator login, and monitoring portal administrator accept a password alone
remediation_plan: Enable MFA on the monitoring portal for all users; integrator enables MFA on the firewall administrator login; remote access MFA delivered by POAM-002
milestones: 2026-09-30 monitoring portal MFA; 2026-11-30 firewall administrator MFA and remote path MFA
resources_required: Included in existing subscriptions and the POAM-002 integrator setup

weakness: Firewall allows any office device to reach the HMI PC; engineering laptop joins office Wi-Fi and the control network; firewall logging off
remediation_plan: Integrator rebuilds firewall rules so no office traffic enters the control network and logging is on; dedicated OT-only engineering laptop; web browsing blocked on the HMI PC (POL-02 B.5)
milestones: 2026-09-30 rule design approved by the Plant Superintendent; 2026-10-31 rules in place, OT-only laptop in use, browsing blocked; 2026-11-15 retest from an office laptop
resources_required: About $2,500 integrator labor and about $1,600 for the laptop

weakness: Integrator's always-on cellular VPN bypasses the firewall; integrator sessions not approved, watched, or recorded at the company
source: P07 (MA-04 and SC-07 objectives); P01 R-003; P03 G-039, G-041
remediation_plan: Interim: router powered off except for sessions a staff member starts and watches; then retire the router and give integrator engineers named, MFA-protected accounts on the POAM-002 path; session request form; security and incident notice terms in the integrator agreement
milestones: 2026-09-15 router-off rule in force; 2026-11-30 router removed and integrator on the single path (contract terms tracked in POAM-013)
resources_required: Integrator labor within the POAM-002 setup

weakness: No company-held copy of PLC logic, the HMI project, or governor and exciter settings; integrator copies from 2023-05-18, unprotected and never verified
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-035; P05 BIA finding 1
remediation_plan: Collect current copies of all OT logic, settings, and firewall configuration onto 2 encrypted drives (office safe and records cabinet) after every change and quarterly; verify against running versions; written OT recovery procedure (POL-04 4.8)
milestones: 2026-10-31 first full set of copies including governor and exciter settings; 2026-12-31 OT recovery procedure approved; 2027-03-31 first restore test on the replacement HMI PC (with POAM-008)

weakness: No OT inventory; only the integrator's 2015 network drawing, which misses the remote desktop tool and the cellular gateway
source: P07 (CM-08 objectives); P03 G-026; P02 tailoring record
remediation_plan: One-page OT inventory with location, firmware, owner, and network connections; list of every connection into the control network; updated with each change form and reviewed every July (POL-04 4.4)
milestones: 2026-10-31 inventory and connection list complete; 2027-07-31 first annual review
resources_required: Staff time (about 2 days) with integrator input

weakness: HMI PC operating system out of vendor support since October 2025 and unpatched since 2024; no tracking of OT firmware or manufacturer advisories
source: P07 (SI-02 objectives); P01 R-006; P03 G-033
remediation_plan: Replace the HMI PC with a supported operating system and current HMI software; quarterly integrator check of OT component versions against manufacturer advisories with defined update windows; until replacement, no browsing and no office access (POAM-004)
milestones: 2026-12-31 first quarterly version check; 2027-01-31 replacement ordered; 2027-03-31 replacement in service and old PC wiped
resources_required: About $9,500 one-time and about $1,200 a year

weakness: Manufacturer default passwords on the camera NVR and the cellular data gateway; HMI password written in a control desk drawer; no rule for changing shared passwords
remediation_plan: Change both default passwords and record the check on the change form; remove the written password and change it; separate camera app logins; password rules in POL-02 B.9
milestones: 2026-08-11 written HMI password removed (done); 2026-09-15 NVR, gateway, and HMI passwords changed and the shared password change rule in use

weakness: No review of remote sessions, HMI journal, or firewall activity; 3 of 64 remote sessions could not be explained until the integrator was asked
source: P07 (AU-06 objectives; log reconciliation); P01 R-001; P03 G-037
remediation_plan: Weekly 15-minute review of remote sessions against the on-call rota and work orders, recorded on a checklist (POL-02 B.7); monthly export of the remote session log kept 1 year; review session alerts once POAM-002 is live
milestones: 2026-09-07 first weekly review; 2026-10-31 monthly log export in place; 2026-11-30 alerts reviewed weekly

weakness: No incident reporting rule or time limit; staff unaware that cyber incidents are conditions reportable under 18 CFR 12.10
source: P07 (IR-06 objectives); P01 R-007; P03 G-009, G-047
remediation_plan: POL-03 reporting rules (approved 2026-08-31); reporting rule in annual training; security and cyber events added to the ODSP communication section; first tabletop with the integrator
milestones: 2026-08-31 POL-03 approved (done); 2026-10-31 all 7 staff trained; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2026-12-31 ODSP updated

weakness: Hoist house key never returned by the former operator-mechanic and lock not changed; gate combinations written on the key cabinet; no key inventory; data logger cabinet unlocked
remediation_plan: Change the hoist house lock; change gate combinations and remove them from the cabinet door; lock the key cabinet and the data logger cabinet; yearly key inventory (POL-02 B.8)
milestones: 2026-09-15 data logger cabinet locked; 2026-09-30 lock and combinations changed, key inventory done

weakness: No security or incident notice terms with the integrator, MSP, or monitoring vendor; vendor oversight not defined; SOC 2 report never reviewed before this engagement
source: P07 (SA-09 objectives); P01 R-018, R-023; P03 G-030
remediation_plan: Security terms at each renewal (named accounts with MFA, 24-hour incident notice, no use of company data for other customers, setpoint-write feature stays off unless the Owner requests it in writing); annual SOC 2 review (POL-02 A.5)
milestones: 2026-08-20 monitoring vendor SOC 2 reviewed (done, P09); 2026-12-31 terms signed with the integrator and monitoring vendor; 2027-03-31 MSP terms at renewal
resources_required: Owner and Office and Compliance Administrator time; terms negotiated at each renewal
